title: Inclined Shelf Book Sorting Cart
description: Original static book sorting cart with two ten-degree backward-inclined shelves, continuous rear backstops, side stops and low front retaining lips. A rigid low chassis, four fixed flat-tread caster assemblies, four continuous uprights and two raised side handles form one functional service cart. Named editable components remain separate. Actual closed-book bottom and rear-face contacts are validated at selected poses; no wheel rotation, steering, load rating or dynamic insertion is promised.
